name: bnb-calendar-prices-sync
description: Extension navigateur : export, import et report annuel des prix du calendrier Airbnb / Abritel

scripts.check: for f in $(find src dev -name "*.js"); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/extension.zip && zip -r dist/extension.zip manifest.json src -x '*.DS_Store'
